prompt: A round pizza has a diameter of $14$ inches. Using $\pi \approx 3.14$, what is its area in square inches, rounded to the nearest whole number?
hint: The formula needs the radius, but you were handed the diameter.

hints.text: The formula needs the radius, but you were handed the diameter.

explanation: Halve the diameter to get the radius: $r = 7$ inches.
Multiply by $\pi$: $3.14 \times 49 = 153.86$, which rounds to $154$ square inches.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why the halving matters so much
steps: Skipping the halving means using $r = 14$, giving $3.14 \times 196 \approx 615$ sq in — four times too big.
Squaring doubles every mistake: a radius that is twice too large makes an area four times too large. Circle the word "diameter" the moment you read it.
